title: Uske phatako me pravesh karunga dhanyawaad ke saath

lines.text: Uske phatako me pravesh karunga dhanyawaad ke saath
Mai kahunga ye din Yehovah ne banaya
Mai khush hua ki aanandit kiya
Mai khush hua ki aanandit kiya

chords:
[CHORUS]
Uske phatako me pravesh karunga dhanyawaad ke saath
Uske aanganon mein stuti karunga
Mai kahunga ye din Yehovah ne banaya
Mai khush hua ki aanandit kiya

[Verse 1]
Aanandit kiya mujhe aanandit kiya
Mai khush hua ki aanandit kiya
(2)
